meta.framework: CS50 Memory / Pointer model → corridor catalog reliability
meta.grounding_notes: Original draft named requirement_facts as the Case Command read path, WorkspaceDB as source of truth, and a 30-day CDN edge cache. ReloPass serves public.requirement_items via requirements_builder; Render is workers=1. This file is the corrected export.

recon.requirement_facts_role: extract/admin/knowledge-doc pipeline, not Case Command reads

parked_related_cards.title: [Architecture] Cache compiled corridor requirements + explicit invalidation on rule change
[AI/ML] Add per-requirement verified_at + days_since_last_verified freshness metric and a staleness queue that visibly downgrades decaying nodes
[Data Quality] Resilient source fetching (httpx timeouts/retries, per-fact try/except, abort partial corridor)
Invalidate attested items on source drift — attested → stale, never the reverse

proposals.title: Compiled requirement_items catalog cache (in-process, short TTL)
proposals.cs50_analogy: Heap allocation — malloc once, reuse across calls rather than re-allocating on every request
proposals.description: Cache the compiled approved catalog from requirements_builder keyed by country_code + purpose + catalog generation token. Render has no CDN edge; TTL is minutes to hours, not 30 days. Must ship with RP-MEM-003.
proposals.why_now: Repeated Case Command / employee requirement lookups hit Postgres for a catalog that changes on lawyer review, not per request. A short TTL plus invalidation keeps the read fast without serving a month-old snapshot.
deliverables: In-process cache key: country_code + purpose + generation token
Cache miss → existing compile → store → return
Log cache_hit vs cache_miss; same PR as RP-MEM-003
proposals.existing_overlap: Parked P2 architecture card on compiled corridor cache. No in-process catalog cache in requirements_builder today. Do not cache requirement_facts.

proposals.title: Requirement decay monitor on last_verified_at
proposals.cs50_analogy: Valgrind for memory leaks — unfreed allocations accumulate silently; stale served rules do the same
proposals.description: Flag approved requirement_items older than a pillar review cycle. Prefer a code-side cycle map (no migration). Stale items stay served but labeled. Do not add last_verified_at to requirement_facts; the column already exists on requirement_items.
proposals.why_now: The catalog is the product. Decay that is invisible becomes a wrong timeline for a paying HR user.
deliverables: Helper: is_stale(item, now) using last_verified_at + pillar cycle
CLI or admin GET: count + breakdown by country_code
Tests: 100-day-old item flagged; fresh not flagged; still served if approved
Optional tiny admin widget; not required for v0
proposals.existing_overlap: last_verified_at already on RequirementItem. attestation_status already has stale. Parked P2 freshness-queue card. WorkspaceDB requirement_decay_queue is empty research mirror — do not use.

proposals.title: Invalidate catalog cache on requirement_items write
proposals.cs50_analogy: free() is mandatory after malloc() — cache entries must be explicitly dropped when the underlying item changes
proposals.description: On INSERT/UPDATE/review_status/promote of requirement_items, drop or bump generation for that country_code. Next builder call misses and reflects the change. Same PR as RP-MEM-001. No background recompile queue for in-process cache.
proposals.why_now: A cached approved catalog shown after a lawyer edit is a trust failure.
deliverables: Per-country invalidation (not global flush unless keyed that way)
Tests: write → miss → new payload; other country untouched
proposals.existing_overlap: Parked P2 cache+invalidation card and Parked P3 attested→stale on source drift (orthogonal axis).

proposals.title: Dependency chain integrity validator
proposals.cs50_analogy: Dangling pointer — depends_on pointing at a deleted entity
proposals.description: Out of P1 scope. Corridor packs already walk depends_on, dangling refs, and cycles in scripts/check_corridor_facts.py check_graph(). Authoring UI + GET /corridors/:id/dependency-health would be a later increment on the pack checker, not a new graph store.
proposals.existing_overlap: scripts/check_corridor_facts.py check_graph() already implements dangling refs + cycles on packs.

proposals.title: Shared requirement entity library
proposals.cs50_analogy: Pointer reuse vs copying whole blocks
proposals.description: Out of P1 scope. Do not create global_requirement_facts. Served rows live in requirement_items with country_code + purpose + title uniqueness. Shared-entity collapse is a later schema design, not Demo Day.

proposals.title: Evidence quote integrity enforcement
proposals.cs50_analogy: Buffer overflow — silently truncated legal quotes
proposals.description: Already shipped. backend/app/services/evidence_quote_validator.py (AIQ-1956) rejects column-cap cuts, U+FFFD, checksum mismatches. Otto ingest tests reject truncated quotes.

proposals.title: Source fetch NULL-check (official ingest)
proposals.cs50_analogy: malloc() returning NULL must be checked — failed fetch is NULL
proposals.description: immigration/fetcher.py already returns FetchedDoc.ok and does not persist a placeholder body. official_ingest_service.ingest_url_to_knowledge_doc still upserts text_content=excerpt or '' on fetch_failed. Close that gap; audit other writers.
proposals.why_now: Empty fetched bodies read as sourced. Lowest-complexity trust fix before Demo Day.
deliverables: official_ingest: fetch_failed does not store empty body as evidence
proposals.existing_overlap: backend/imports/immigration/fetcher.py is the correct contract. Parked P2 resilient fetching card. backfill_fact_evidence.py already maps ok=false to fetch_failed.

summary.core_theme: Memory-safe programs check NULL, free on mutation, and do not serve dangling pointers. ReloPass analog: failed fetches are not evidence, approved items have visible decay, compiled catalogs are reused only with write-time invalidation. Serve requirement_items, not requirement_facts.
